# DEV-54: PHP SDK witness after Symfony security updates

The Gate candidate `f9added4a183fb7c683c529ab46c23f4cbd94d72` changed the PHP SDK dependency closure: Symfony `http-foundation` and `http-kernel` from 7.4.23 to 7.4.24. The SDK initialization fingerprint is `sha256:da96693bee8c5b0437ef79d17258a2bc2d33d97fa64443597a51278e7e39a4e7`. Routing, privacy-filter and deployment-symbol fingerprints remain unchanged. Browser and Nitro component witnesses retain their original source, run and artifacts; no new browser or Nitro event is claimed.

[Release CI 45884649226, attempt 1](https://github.com/Tuinstra-DEV/gate/actions/runs/45884649226) produced the PHP OCI index `sha256:f4104f7f948c7e335d0bf8f2dd7a6f6b398853541abfe743b9202846b07a7989`. Artifact 15149168637 had ZIP SHA-256 `5863c9fbf4f7b3ca339c4f32eb696ce0c95a11a0645bd71255c195b530e585d8`. Its OCI configuration, blobs and layer identities were checked before isolated execution of the actual image. PHP 8.3.36 and all 11 intended Symfony 7.4.24 packages were confirmed.

One actual SDK verification event `1646313d7f2848c8a21e7eeb7c7d110c` reached Sentry issue 164233430 at 2026-11-27T17:02:03.392113Z. Readback confirmed the exact release, verification environment, source frame `backend/src/Service/Heal/HealRunnerFailureReporter.php:42`, no processing errors, no populated user fields and removal of a synthetic private marker. The matching Heal case `6b994d6332e04aff89d740a1791a5436` retained the same source and OCI digest and receipt digest `sha256:e6640b698dd2d117fc1345a6ab9426a6377ab9aafed5cef9f860e539ee25aa96`; it had one occurrence, one triage attempt and zero fix attempts. This proves one intake, not a fresh duplicate delivery. Historical duplicate-delivery and local retry regression evidence remains attributed to `gate-local-verification.md`.

The ledger was backed up and updated under its existing lock with prior rows and mounted inode retained; the worker was refreshed with the same image. The event was produced in the verification environment, not by a production request or deployment. This witness does not establish promotion, production readiness or authorization to skip required checks.
